title: Prepare Review URL (Skill trigger)
instructions:
## Purpose
Review how the coding agent prepares a non-empty, validated artifact and hands its local review URL to the reviewer.

## Regeneration
Inspect skills/architecture-companion/SKILL.md, specs/agent-handoff-architecture.spec.ts, and the view-artifacts, view-generators, validate-schemas, and serve CLI commands. Reconstruct the new-artifact preparation flow from catalog discovery and placement selection through generator discovery and authoring through the non-empty artifact check, validation and correction loop, server startup, and URL handoff. Keep this diagram focused on preparation rather than the subsequent interactive review.

nodes.title: Receive an architecture review request
nodes.description: The coding agent starts preparing a review for the designated consumer scope.

nodes.title: Discover available generators
nodes.description: The agent harness discovers built-in, global, and project generator manifests.

nodes.title: Write the artifact
nodes.description: Write JSON artifacts with an explicit behavior or design kind, using the current request, saved placement instructions, and existing conventions. Create the initial config with **/*.archcomp.json when needed.

nodes.title: Run the Architecture Companion server
nodes.description: Start the server for the designated scope and print the loopback URL.

nodes.title: Does the artifact contain diagrams and pass validation?
nodes.description: Use view-artifacts to confirm at least one discovered artifact exists, then validate the entire catalog before sharing a URL.

nodes.title: Complete or fix the artifact
nodes.description: Add the requested diagrams if none exist. Fix validation errors and rerun validate-schemas until it prints Catalog is valid.

nodes.title: Hand off review URL
nodes.description: Explain what the validated catalog covers and hand the review URL to the reviewer.

nodes.title: Read the catalog and placement context
nodes.description: Discover central and co-located artifacts with view-artifacts. Read configuration and user rules; ask about placement only when this is a new environment without an existing instruction or artifact.
